item.name: Enterprise
item.description: LDAP, branding, custom domains, audit exports and compliance reports

query.description: Filter by type: soc2, iso27001, gdpr
Filter by status: generating, completed, failed

request.description: List generated compliance reports for the authenticated user's organization, paginated and ordered by generated_at desc. All query params are optional. Requires OAuth scope: enterprise.compliance.read.

Stream a generated compliance report file. Returns application/pdf or application/json based on ?format. Returns 410 Gone if the report has expired (default 180-day retention), 404 if not found or owned by another organization, 400 if the report is still generating. Requires OAuth scope: enterprise.compliance.read.

Schedule automated compliance reports. Persists a row in scheduled_compliance_reports and dispatches the first run immediately. Returns the persisted schedule under data.schedule with {id, report_type, frequency, recipients, is_active, next_run_at, last_run_at, created_at}. Requires OAuth scope: enterprise.compliance.manage.
List all scheduled compliance reports for the authenticated user's organization. Requires OAuth scope: enterprise.compliance.read.
Update a scheduled compliance report. All fields are optional - pass only what you want to change. Recomputes next_run_at when frequency changes. Requires OAuth scope: enterprise.compliance.manage.
Cancel a scheduled compliance report so no further runs are dispatched. Requires OAuth scope: enterprise.compliance.manage.
Verify DNS records for custom domain
Synchronize users from LDAP to AuthOS
